The '''Crystal Forest''' was a formation on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Samaria/Legends|Samaria]]. It was a large [[Forest/Legends|expanse]] of [[Crystal/Legends|crystallized]] [[Tree/Legends|trees]] that had formed when the planet was still cold and covered in [[Water/Legends|ice]]. Although the region was a popular tourist attraction, for the most part, it was still barren and wild, devoid of animals.

In [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]], street kid [[Trever Flume]] and resistance organizer [[Eve Yarrow|Flame]] met up in the Crystal Forest, where Trever narrowly escaped being killed by [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]].
